sidebarNote:
Local workspace
Preview before applying, undo after
banner: Local route workspace. Engine sessions bind to a loopback port only; the system network is never taken over.
overview.subtitle: Current status, profile, and items that need attention.
session.idle.sub: The active profile is ready. Start a session or inspect a route directly.
session.starting.sub: Checking rule formats and the default route.
session.running.sub: The engine session is up on a loopback port. Route checks run against the active profile.
session.stopConfirm.title: Stop the current session?
session.stopConfirm.body: Rules and profiles stay unchanged. You can start again at any time.
session.startConfirm.title: Start the current session?
session.startConfirm.body: The profile is validated first; the session starts only when validation passes.
session.engineUnavailable: Engine binary not configured. Sessions stay unavailable; everything else keeps working.
pending.title: Attention
pending.clear.title: Nothing needs attention
pending.clear.body: Every profile is validated and all set expectations match.
pending.invalidHint: This profile has unresolved issues. Open it to fix the rules.
targets.title: Saved targets
targets.empty: No saved targets yet. Check a route and save it.
events.title: Activity
trace.subtitle: Compare expectations with the computed route and find the deciding rule.
trace.error.domain: Enter a domain, e.g. nas.lab.internal; no scheme, path, or spaces.
trace.expectation.label: Your expectation
trace.expectation.note: Expectations only set the comparison standard; rules stay unchanged.
trace.cause.final: No earlier rule matched; the FINAL fallback decided.
trace.cause.exact: Rule %lld (exact domain) matched first; it decides the result.
trace.cause.suffix: Rule %lld (domain suffix) matched first; it decides the result.
trace.cause.cidr: Rule %lld (IP CIDR) matched; it decides the result.
trace.cause.none: No rule in this profile covers this target.
trace.steps.title: Decision process
trace.step.nomatch.body: Add a target rule or a FINAL fallback, then check again.
trace.step.out.direct: Final policy DIRECT; no proxy group resolution.
trace.step.out.reject: Final policy REJECT; no exit selection.
trace.technical.title: Check record & technical details
trace.technical.execution.value: RelayPilot rule evaluation via engine RPC
patch.title: Modify this route
patch.body: Adds one priority rule for this target only; other rules keep their order.
patch.note: Adds an exact DOMAIN rule at the top of the rule list. You can review old and new results before applying.
patch.confirm.title: Confirm route change
patch.confirm.body: Affects only this target in the active profile; you can undo after applying.
patch.same: The result already matches; nothing to apply.
profiles.subtitle: Find, validate, and switch profiles. Viewing never switches the active profile.
profiles.pick.body: Click a profile to see its rules, validation status, and actions.
profiles.nomatch.body: Try different keywords, or clear the filters to see everything.
profiles.rules.title: Routing rules
profiles.issues.title: Validation issues
switch.title: Switch the active profile?
switch.body.running: The running session keeps its current configuration until you restart it.
switch.body.idle: Switching applies to later route checks.
delete.title: Delete this profile?
delete.body: The profile file is removed from your library folder.
delete.activeRefused: The active profile cannot be deleted.
editor.title: Edit routing rules
editor.body: One rule per line; validate and review before saving.
editor.grammar: Supported kinds: DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, IP-CIDR, IP-CIDR6, GEOIP, FINAL. Policies: DIRECT, REJECT, and this profile's groups and nodes.
editor.confirm.title: Confirm rule changes
editor.confirm.body.active: This changes the active profile; routes recompute immediately. You can undo.
editor.confirm.body.other: Only this profile changes; it will not become active.
import.title: Import a profile
import.body: Paste configuration text and review the supported scope first. The original file is never modified.
import.name: Profile name
import.error.name: Enter a valid, unused profile name.
import.error.empty: No importable rules were found. Add supported rules and policies.
import.preview.title: Import preview
import.preview.body: Confirm what to keep, then create the new profile.
import.preview.allSupported: Everything is within the supported scope.
import.ack: I understand these lines are not imported; the new profile may behave differently.
import.mappingNote: Unavailable proxies and groups become placeholder select groups that fall back to DIRECT. This is not a full Surge converter.
import.created: Profile created; the active profile is unchanged.
settings.subtitle: Appearance, privacy, and change protection.
settings.redact.desc: Diagnostic exports keep rule kinds and results but drop target domains and trace ids.
settings.export.desc: Save the current route check record as local JSON.
settings.quickfind.desc: Find pages, profiles, or saved targets.
settings.keyboard.desc: Press / to focus the current search; in Quick Find use ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to open, Esc to close.
settings.previewGuard.desc: Rule changes always show the scope and impact before you confirm.
settings.ai.desc: Not connected. Profiles never leave this machine.
settings.note: Preferences are stored on this machine. Profiles live in your library folder.
qf.title: Quick Find
qf.subtitle: Pages, profiles, and saved targets.
qf.placeholder: Profile name, domain, or page name
qf.hint: ↑ ↓ to choose · Enter to open · Esc to close
qf.empty: No matches. Try a profile name, domain, or page name.
overview.emptyLibrary.title: The library is empty
overview.emptyLibrary.body: Import a profile and this page shows the active profile, its default route and the profiles to deal with.
targets.duplicate: This target is already in the list.
trace.prompt: Enter a target domain to start; the engine decides against the active profile.
trace.copyFallback: Clipboard access was refused; select the text below to copy it manually.
